conventions.battery: one battery per form x instruction language (lang: the language Jugnu speaks); reading tasks keep their own language
conventions.modes: tap: Jugnu says the item, the child taps it among the choices; record: the child reads aloud and the audio is scored later; both: record, then the tap side
conventions.stop: first_line_n/first_line_min_correct = EGRA early stop (no correct item in the first row or line); consecutive_errors = Core EGMA; time_up = the 60-second clock
conventions.feedback: right/wrong feedback on practice items only; scored items get none (EGRA)
conventions.audio: audio keys are sa/v1/<lang>/<sha1(lang|text)[0,12]>.mp3 under the served SA audio base; a missing clip falls back to the browser's speech of the same text
conventions.digits: maths items show Western digits; Urdu speech uses Urdu digits (v3 convention)
